notes: Modified cash basis village audit. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5); fund balance roll-forward 354,934 -> 398,054 (p5). Insurance proceeds 8,533 (Other Financing Sources) in other_financing, loan proceeds 150,000 (Street) in debt_proceeds, transfers in 65,700 (General 30,000 = Fire 15,000 + City Hall 15,000; Street 35,700) from the Electric (50,700) and Water (15,000) funds. Governmental cash: governmental funds Cash 67,631 (2022 column 92,154), CDs 136,809 (2022: 135,352) as investments; cash held by county treasurer 6,048 (Street) is a separate line not included in ending_cash. Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary statement Total column (p7), which ties to the Statement of Activities (p2: charges 911,111 incl. 'Other' 827; expenditures 902,853 incl. debt service); net position 569,945 -> 520,206. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) because the governmental funds statement (p3) carries due from/to other funds (400,580 total) rather than the internal balance; the governmental funds balance sheet (p3), proprietary funds statement (p6) and General Fund asset balances by department (p11) are also in the trim. Detail: General Fund by department (p12), Street (p13), Fitness Center (p14), ARPA (p15, no 2023 activity), utility funds from the proprietary statement columns (p7); the all-funds budgetary comparison (p10, one combined column) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Statement capital outlay 202,716 kept as one line (General/Park 16,154 + Street 186,562; no single printed function). Read pages 1-15 of 15
